svg.title: What to check when Windows desktop icons disappear: Display settings and the View menu
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check when Windows desktop icons disappear:
Display settings and the View menu
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-31
Turn on desktop icons in the View menu
① Right-click an empty area of the desktop where
there are no icons.
Check theme settings if only system
icons are missing
Default icons such as This PC, Recycle Bin,
Network, and User's Files are managed separately
in the Settings app.
Determine whether the files are
actually missing
Icons not being visible and files being gone are
different issues.
Checklist before restoring them
- Before deleting or creating icons, first check
whether the files remain in the Desktop folder.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
